post.title: 5 Signs Your Texts Sound Meaner Than You Think #shorts
post.description: How many did you check? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who checks all five. Dev texts Milo 'Nice job, genius' as a joke, and Milo reads an insult. 'ok.' with a full stop, a joke with no emoji, rereading it after you send, a reply that's just 'what?', being sure they'll know you're kidding: your tone lives in your head, not in the text. In 'Egocentrism Over E-Mail: Can We Communicate as Well as We Think?' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2005), Justin Kruger, Nicholas Epley, Jason Parker and Zhi-Wen Ng had people send sarcastic or serious statements: senders predicted their partner would read the tone right about 78% of the time; over email, partners got it right only about 56%, barely better than chance. You hear your voice. They don't. Add the emoji. #psychology #shorts #texting #overthinking #communication
